sanhedrim.definition:
n. the great council of the Jews, which consisted of
   seventy members, to whom the high priest was added. It had jurisdiction
   of religious matters.
sanhedrim.translation: (古犹太国的)最高法院兼参议会(由71人组成, 兼管宗教事务)

sanhedrin.definition: n the supreme judicial and ecclesiastical council of ancient Jerusalem
sanhedrin.translation: n. 古犹太最高评议会兼最高法院
